title: Crane symbols match Sheehan's drawings
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: what he had draw is very close to what I seen

plain: Randy Anderson, a man who says he saw alien technology at a military base, says that symbols he saw in 2014 at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy research site in Indiana, closely matched drawings made by Dan Sheehan, who had drawn symbols he said he had seen on a crashed craft. Anderson tells Michels: "what he had draw is very close to what I seen"; if true, it would tie two separate witnesses to the same object or writing.
